metadata.title: Tech Selloff Cools. Now the Heat Is on the Dow.

content.text:
3 hours ago
The tech stock selloff took a breather on Friday, but don't expect it to be the end of AI trade worries.
The S&P 500 slid 0.5% while the Nasdaq Composite dropped 0.2%. The indexes fell 1.1% and 2.6%, respectively, the previous day. The Dow Industrial Average felt the brunt of Friday's weakness, falling 1.2%, or 653 points.
The Dow effectively made up for the losses it missed out on Thursday, when it closed flat. While the blue-chip index was still able to eke out a positive weekly return, the same couldn't be said for the other two major indexes.
